lines.japanese: 「～の危険を冒す」のことで、他にも重要な意味があるから注意、と……。
lines.english: “It means ‘to run the risk of,’ but it has other important senses too, so take care...”

lines.japanese: うん、中々できてんじゃん。これで全教科予習したかな。
lines.english: “Yeah, that's not half bad. Have I finished preparing for every subject now?”

lines.japanese: さて、今日の分は終わりっと……。
lines.english: All right, that's it for today...

lines.japanese: あー、終わりじゃなかったな。なに普通に寝ようとしてんだ俺。
lines.english: “Oh, right. It wasn't over. What am I doing, casually trying to go to sleep?”

lines.japanese: そうだ、おまえがいたんだよな。にしても不思議なやつだなー。おまえだけ俺と一つにならなかったもんな。
lines.english: “That's right. You're still here. You really are a strange one, though. You're the only one who never became part of me.”

lines.japanese: よう、末っ子。ここまでずっと見てきたんだろ？
lines.english: “Hey, kiddo. You've been watching us all this way, haven't you?”

lines.japanese: でももうこっから先、おまえが見るもんはないんだ。
lines.english: “But from this point on, there's nothing left for you to watch.”

lines.japanese: ていうか現在進行形だから、ここから先は長い長い時間がかかるんだ。
lines.english: “I mean, this is all happening in real time now. Whatever comes next will take a long, long time.”

lines.japanese: 長いことお疲れさま。これにて俺の物語はおしまい。
lines.english: “Thanks for staying so long. And with that, my story is over.”

lines.japanese: 最後にざっと近況報告だけしておくか。
lines.english: “I suppose I'll give you a quick update before the end.”

lines.japanese: さしあたって今は受験勉強をがんばってる。
lines.english: “For the moment, I'm working hard at my entrance-exam studies.”

lines.japanese: もうカウンセラーさんの元に通うこともなくなったし、これだけ安定してれば、今度こそ受験に専念できそうだ。
lines.english: “I don’t need to see the counselor anymore, and now that I’m doing this well, it looks like I can finally focus on my entrance exams.”

lines.japanese: まあおまえだからぶっちゃけるけど、そのあとの目標ってのはまだ決まってない。
lines.english: “Well, since it's you, I'll be honest. I still haven't decided what I want to aim for afterward.”

lines.japanese: もし俺が、いや俺たちが別々に生きてれば、それぞれの目標や生き甲斐があったのかもしれない。
lines.english: “If I—or rather, if we—had continued living separately, perhaps each of us would have had their own ambitions and their own reason to live.”

lines.japanese: でも各々が得てきたものを持ちよったんだから、その総合的な知識や経験を生かせる目標を持ちたいんだ。
lines.english: “But now that we've pooled everything each of us gained, I want a goal that will put all that knowledge and experience to use.”

lines.japanese: で、どうしようか考えたとき行きついた答えが、まずは受験勉強をしようってことだった。
lines.english: “And when I asked myself what to do, the answer I reached was to start by studying for the entrance exams.”

lines.japanese: 幸い今までの貯えがあるおかげで時間に余裕はある。目標を探すための時間を無駄にしないためにも、大学に進むのはいまある選択肢の中では最上のものだと思う。
lines.english: “Fortunately, what we saved before gives me time to spare. University seems like the best option I have: it lets me search for a purpose without wasting the time along the way.”

lines.japanese: 今は選べる道が多すぎて、具体的な道が見つからないんだ。おまえだって、一本だと思ってた道が、ある日霧が晴れて十本に増えてたらびっくりすんだろ？
lines.english: “Right now there are too many roads I could choose, and I can't find the one road that is mine. You'd be surprised too, wouldn't you, if the mist lifted one day and the road you thought was the only one split into ten?”

lines.japanese: でもその先のことを考えたとき、なにをするにしても、夢見ごとじゃない、確かな実感がある。
lines.english: “But when I look farther ahead, whatever I may end up doing, I feel a solid certainty there—something real, not some daydream.”

lines.japanese: 意識の中で五体満足な俺は、もう心のことを気づかって未来に遠慮することなんてない。
lines.english: “Whole in my own consciousness, I no longer need to tiptoe around my heart or hold myself back from the future.”

lines.japanese: これは凄く恵まれたことだと思うんだ。俺のことを見てきたおまえなら分かってくれると思う。
lines.english: “I think I’m incredibly lucky to have that. You’ve watched me all this way, so I think you know what I mean.”

lines.japanese: てことは、おまえがこれから先はなにをしなくちゃいけないのかも分かるよな？
lines.english: “Which means you know what you have to do from here on too, don't you?”

lines.japanese: ま、ゆっくりでいいさ。俺だってここまでくるのに大した時間がかかってる。
lines.english: “Well, take your time. It took me long enough to come this far.”

lines.japanese: 俺はこれから、明日より先にある未来を待ちわびながら、今日一日を有意義に過ごしていくよ。
lines.english: “From now on, I'll make each day count while looking forward to the future waiting beyond tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: なんだったら俺と一緒になるか？　はは、冗談だって。
lines.english: “Or would you like to become part of me? Ha-ha. I'm joking.”

lines.japanese: ああ、そういや最後にひとつ。ネットで見たんだけど、おまえみたいなやつのこと、専門的には死神じゃなくてＩＳＨって呼ぶらしいよ。
lines.english: “Oh, right. One last thing. I read online that the technical term for somebody like you isn't a ‘reaper.’ It's an Inner Self Helper—an ISH.”

lines.japanese: 俺たちみたいにバラバラなやつらをまとめて、救済してくれる存在なんだってさ。
lines.english: Apparently, an ISH is something that gathers scattered people like us together and saves them.

lines.japanese: ありがとう。いままで導いてくれて。俺たち全員から礼を言わせてもらう。
lines.english: Thank you. Thank you for guiding us this far. All of us want to say it.

lines.japanese: んじゃな、末っ子。夢テレビは一日一時間だぞ。
lines.english: “Take care, kiddo. Dream TV's limited to one hour a day.”

lines.japanese: おやすみなさい、また明日。
lines.english: Good night. See you tomorrow.
